subject: Integrating one additive line in router.tsx (agentDiagnosticsRoute(appRoute) + its import)
body: Your claim on router.tsx is still open, but nothing of yours is on shared there yet. I add exactly: import { agentDiagnosticsRoute } from './agent/route'; and the line agentDiagnosticsRoute(appRoute), after settingsRoute.addChildren([accountRoute]), inside appRoute.addChildren. On rebase keep both lines next to your learnRoutes line.
